Rin BepInEx Mono redistributed dependency notice inventory

This directory contains the reviewed license and third-party notice texts for
the eight pinned .NET libraries that package_bepinex.py redistributes in the
BepInEx Mono install ZIP. It does not apply to the IL2CPP package, which does
not redistribute these libraries.

All eight NuGet packages carry the same Microsoft MIT LICENSE.TXT. Its text is
stored once as LICENSE-DOTNET.txt with CRLF line endings normalized to LF.
Identical THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT files are also stored once and mapped below.
No notice text has otherwise been edited.

Redistributed library / locked NuGet version / reviewed notice asset:

- Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces.dll / Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces 8.0.0 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-MICROSOFT-BCL-8.0.txt
- System.Buffers.dll / System.Buffers 4.5.1 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-DOTNET-STANDARD-2.0.txt
- System.Memory.dll / System.Memory 4.5.5 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-DOTNET-STANDARD-2.0.txt
- System.Numerics.Vectors.dll / System.Numerics.Vectors 4.4.0 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-NUMERICS-VECTORS-4.4.txt
- System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.dll /
  System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe 6.0.0 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-RUNTIME-UNSAFE-6.0.txt
- System.Text.Encodings.Web.dll / System.Text.Encodings.Web 8.0.0 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-MICROSOFT-BCL-8.0.txt
- System.Text.Json.dll / System.Text.Json 8.0.6 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-TEXT-JSON-8.0.6.txt
- System.Threading.Tasks.Extensions.dll /
  System.Threading.Tasks.Extensions 4.5.4 /
  THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES-DOTNET-STANDARD-2.0.txt
